summary: This round adds a durable `sidebar.e2e.test.ts` that covers Artifacts filtering, favorites of stopped extensions, and section collapse and reorder. It also trims the temp E2E. The source is unchanged since round 5 and still sound, and I accept the new durable file as a guard for the merged sidebar. The coverage gate now fails: the temp test "quick actions and section controls work without reloading" was deleted. The new durable reorder test drags and presses ArrowUp before `page.reload()`, so the reload discards that coverage. As a result, 26 changed lines are uncovered: the toolbar's New chat session, New folder, and Desktop handlers, and the section drag and keyboard handlers.

findings.body: The coverage gate fails with 26 uncovered changed lines: Sidebar.tsx 77, 81, 109-110, and 124-125, and SidebarSection.tsx 85-90, 92-97, 100-101, 154-155, and 161-164. Two things caused this. First, the temp test that ran the toolbar actions and the section drag and keyboard reorder without a reload ("quick actions and section controls work without reloading") was removed. Second, the new durable "collapses and reorders sidebar sections" test does its drag and ArrowUp before `app.page.reload()`. Round 1 showed that this resets the renderer's V8 coverage, so those handlers never register as covered. Restore a no-reload test that clicks New chat session, New folder, and Desktop and performs the drag and arrow-key reorder. It can be temp, or the durable reorder test can assert the order before reloading in a separate test. Alternatively, move the reload persistence check into its own test so the interaction test ends without a reload.

testRequests.target: Sidebar.tsx:77-81, 109-110, 124-125 (New chat session, New folder, and Desktop toolbar handlers) and SidebarSection.tsx:85-101, 154-155, 161-164 (section dragOver, drop, dragStart, and ArrowUp/ArrowDown reorder), run in a page session that is not reloaded before coverage is collected
testRequests.rationale: These are uncovered changed lines. Earlier rounds covered them with a no-reload temp test, which was removed this round.
